body.condition: The full finite two-terminal stopped Hankel array with prefix and suffix words \(u,w\in\mathcal Y^{\le K-1}\), terminal labels \(b\in\{R,A\}\), and entries \(F_b(uw)\) has rank \(K\).

novel.justification: This tailored stopped-law realization condition concerns the full paired risk-and-adoption Hankel array. Every entry is an observable stopped-word probability, and rank \(K\) guarantees that some \(K\times K\) minor is nonsingular. It does not guarantee that the particular tuple \(\mathcal U,\mathcal V\) fixed before observing outcomes selects such a minor; that separate requirement is directly auditable from its observable entries.
